integrity: Two different state-space encodings and direct physical-bond enumeration all independently check the sixteen exact sectors. All numerical multiplicities are exhaustive finite counts, while exact energy minima and crossings also have a separate analytic discrete-convexity proof.
scientific_limitations: The classification is a zero-temperature, three-color, fifteen-site finite-graph result with homogeneous antiferromagnetic coupling; no thermal limit or unindexed-priority conclusion is proved.
title: Five four-sector coexistence fields in the triangular-graph Potts antiferromagnet
